query:
INSERT INTO organization_memberships (
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            role,
            status,
            deactivated_at
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            'ADMIN'::user_role,
            'ACTIVE'::membership_status,
            NULL
         )
         RETURNING role::text AS "role!", status::text AS "status!"
